description.en: The ID of the agent that executes the task.

description.zh: 首次执行后自动删除，默认false
description.en: Specifies whether to automatically delete the job after its first execution. This is useful for one-time tasks. Default: `false`.
The configuration for delivering task execution results.
Specifies whether the cron job is enabled. Default: `true`.
The unique name of the task.

description.zh: 创建后是否重启网关，默认true
description.en: Specifies whether to restart the gateway upon job creation. Default: `true`.

description.zh: 是否创建后立即执行一次，默认false
description.en: Specifies whether to run the job once immediately upon creation. Default: `false`.
The session routing key, which determines the conversation session for the task.
The session target. Valid values are `main`, `isolated`, and `current`.
The wake mode for the agent. Valid values are `now` and `next-heartbeat`.

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明

通过此API，用户可以定义并创建一个新的定时任务（Cron Job），该任务将根据给定的时间表定期触发，并携带特定的消息或指令。支持自定义任务的执行频率、时区设置以及失败后的警报机制等高级选项。此外，还可以配置消息的内容、目标渠道及接收者等详细信息。
descriptions.en:
## Request

Use this API to create a cron job. You can configure the job's payload, execution frequency, timezone, target channel, recipients, and a failure alert mechanism.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb create-polar-claw-cron-job --application-id pa-00000000000000 --name daily-report --schedule Expr=0_9_0_0_0 Tz=Asia/Shanghai Kind=cron --session-target main --wake-mode now --payload '{"Message":"Generate_the_daily_report.","Kind":"agentTurn"}' --agent-id main --session-key agent:main:feishu:direct:000 --description Daily_report_generation --enabled true --delete-after-run false --delivery Mode=announce Channel=telegram --failure-alert Channel=telegram After=3 --run-immediately false --restart true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb CreatePolarClawCronJob --region cn-hangzhou --Description Daily_report_generation --Enabled true --WakeMode now --Restart true --Name 'daily-report' --RunImmediately false --SessionKey 'agent:main:feishu:direct:000' --DeleteAfterRun false --Schedule '{"Expr":"0_9_0_0_0","Tz":"Asia/Shanghai","Kind":"cron"}' --SessionTarget main --Payload '{"Message":"Generate_the_daily_report.","Kind":"agentTurn"}' --AgentId main --Delivery '{"Mode":"announce","Channel":"telegram"}' --FailureAlert '{"Channel":"telegram","After":3}' --ApplicationId 'pa-00000000000000'
